groups.name: Inspect first
groups.grammar: root ::= "read the failing test\n" | "inspect the error log\n"

result.semantics: Relative mass over measured token paths including a common newline, excluding EOS. Not the total probability of arbitrary grammar languages or all tokenizations.
result.prompt:
STATE:
A test failed after a parser change. The failure has not been read yet.
QUESTION: What should the developer do next?
Choose exactly one of these next steps:
read the failing test
inspect the error log
edit the parser
restart the service
Output its exact text followed by one newline. No explanation.
